comments.text:
Implement TopBar Vizia view with studio set selector and selected part tone info.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.13 (MixerPage)

ELEMENTS:
- Studio set selector: dropdown (0-63) showing current studio set name, with Load Names button to fetch all 64 names via catalog query
- Tone info: clickable text showing 'Part N : ToneType : PC : ToneName' for the selected part
- Clicking tone info opens the ToneSelector (i7-49c.15)

REFERENCE:
- web/src/TopBar.tsx: complete React implementation
- web/src/StudioSetSelector.tsx: studio set dropdown with lazy name loading

title: VST/Vizia: implement TopBar with studio set selector and tone info
